verified: Hyundai publicly revealed a production-ready Neira, described as a three-row, seven-seat electric SUV, with an Indonesia launch set for November 20, as reported by Electrek.
unconfirmed: Range, battery capacity, charging speed, price and production volume; whether other markets will get the Neira; and whether the November 20 date marks the start of customer deliveries or only a market premiere, since the report does not specify.

verified: 据 Electrek 报道，现代公开了量产版 Neira，为三排七座纯电 SUV，定于 11 月 20 日在印度尼西亚上市。
unconfirmed: 车型的具体规格（电池、续航、动力、充电能力）、售价，以及印度尼西亚以外的销售计划；这些信息在现有报道中均未披露，需等现代在上市时公布或第三方实测。

titles.en: Hyundai unveils production Neira, a seven-seat EV for Indonesia
titles.zh: 现代发布七座纯电SUV Neira，11月20日印尼上市
